Tech demo of Innova Space’s new pico-satellite constellation for IoT.

Description

Tech demo of Innova Space’s new pico-satellite platform, designed to provide IoT communications to Latin America’s growing agriculture, mining, oil & gas sectors as part of a wider constellation of satellites.
